definitions.explanation: The design or practice of letting natural light into a building through windows, skylights, or other openings. An important consideration in architecture and interior design.

examples.japanese: {採光|さいこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧だ。
examples.english: This room has good natural lighting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{採光|さいこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Large windows ensure sufficient natural lighting.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{採光|さいこう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{換気|かんき}→換気：00172_kanki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{両立|りょうりつ}→両立：11310_ryouritsu⟧⟦させている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This design achieves both natural lighting and ventilation.

notes:
{採光|さいこう} combines {採|さい} (to gather) and {光|こう} (light) — literally "gathering light."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {採光|さいこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧/わるい — good/poor natural lighting
- {採光|さいこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to secure natural lighting
- {採光|さいこう}⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧ — window for natural lighting

In Japanese building regulations, residential rooms must meet minimum {採光|さいこう} standards. Real estate listings frequently mention {採光|さいこう} as a selling point, especially for south-facing rooms (⟦{南向|みなみむ}き→南向き：22595_minamimuki⟧).
